svg.script: { "diagramType": "C4 Component Diagram", "projectName": "Food Delivery System", "description": "Level 3: Components within API container", "container": "API Server", "components": [ {"id": "ctrl1", "name": "Order Controller", "type": "controller", "position": {"x": 200, "y": 300}}, {"id": "ctrl2", "name": "User Controller", "type": "controller", "position": {"x": 200, "y": 450}}, {"id": "ctrl3", "name": "Restaurant Controller", "type": "controller", "position": {"x": 200, "y": 600}}, {"id": "svc1", "name": "Order Service", "type": "service", "position": {"x": 700, "y": 300}}, {"id": "svc2", "name": "User Service", "type": "service", "position": {"x": 700, "y": 450}}, {"id": "svc3", "name": "Restaurant Service", "type": "service", "position": {"x": 700, "y": 600}}, {"id": "repo1", "name": "Order Repository", "type": "repository", "position": {"x": 1300, "y": 300}}, {"id": "repo2", "name": "User Repository", "type": "repository", "position": {"x": 1300, "y": 450}}, {"id": "repo3", "name": "Restaurant Repository", "type": "repository", "position": {"x": 1300, "y": 600}} ], "relationships": [ {"from": "ctrl1", "to": "svc1"}, {"from": "ctrl2", "to": "svc2"}, {"from": "ctrl3", "to": "svc3"}, {"from": "svc1", "to": "repo1"}, {"from": "svc2", "to": "repo2"}, {"from": "svc3", "to": "repo3"} ], "designTokens": {"lightMode": {"canvas": "#FFFFFF"}, "darkMode": {"canvas": "#0D0D0D"}} }
